bio: Situated within the heart of Stratford-upon-Avon,  directly opposite the world-renowned Royal Shakespeare Company Theatres, The Arden is a contemporary 4-star boutique hotel and home to chic Waterside Brasserie, the perfect place to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  No 44 Brasserie on The Waterside offers a tranquil atmosphere to indulge in Afternoon Tea, featuring its own elegant champagne bar, and large arched windows flood natural light into the restaurant's pastel interior.
